isolation.notes: Cases reuse deterministic, tmp_path-isolated contracts. This is a product integration regression set, not a blind generalization benchmark. v2 (2026-08-31) extends v1's 24 cases to 36: each of the six areas gains two cross-module invariants (COMPLETE_TEST_PLAN §8.1) - suggestion governance, schema hard-reject, API-level veto, keyword-boundary safety, idempotent saves, bidirectional sync, illegal status rejection, unbound-JD fencing, corrupted-memory recovery, concurrent-append integrity, node degradation, and replay idempotency.

cases.contract: All synthetic persona fixtures satisfy the profile schema.
A missing profile file degrades to the documented fallback without writing user data.
Profile reads reflect an isolated file edit instead of stale cached state.
Conflicting profile writes and suggestion decisions preserve optimistic concurrency.
A rejected profile suggestion cannot be re-approved without new verified evidence.
The profile schema hard-rejects a record missing a required field instead of silently accepting it.
The frozen synthetic JD match set meets its deterministic acceptance threshold.
Preferred education wording is not misread as a hard requirement when the JD says no restriction.
Preferred experience wording is not misread as a hard requirement when no experience is allowed.
Explicit remote support overrides an otherwise incompatible office-city check.
A clearly unsuitable JD is vetoed through the public /api/match endpoint by rules alone, without any LLM call.
Short latin keywords do not false-match inside longer unrelated words.
The exact date view resolves the expected daily plan tasks.
Saving today's tasks round-trips and synchronizes in an isolated plan directory.
A stale plan modification time is rejected rather than overwriting newer work.
Multiple missed days raise a visible plan-drift warning.
Replacing a day's tasks round-trips losslessly, so repeated saves stay idempotent.
The plan API keeps the day view and the overall plan synchronized in both directions.
Legacy applications gain stable IDs without inventing a JD binding.
Approved JD and match artifacts are immutable and reproducible.
Changing JD text creates a new version instead of mutating history.
A changed application target marks the plan snapshot stale without rewriting the plan.
The application store rejects an illegal status value instead of recording it.
An application without a bound JD cannot enter the JD-driven plan flow.
A reflection event round-trips through isolated episodic memory.
A high-deviation streak is distilled into a persistent adjustment.
Repeated reflections for the same task are deduplicated within one day.
A verifier-corrected value reaches episodic memory and recent lessons.
A corrupted semantic memory file is backed up and recovered without losing distilled sediment.
Concurrent episodic appends never interleave records.
Unsupported auto-apply and LinkedIn claims are flagged as fabrication.
The resume critic rejects a fabricated capability before approval.
Resume workshop selection uses the JD bound to an application, not temporary analysis text.
A suitable synthetic JD traverses the complete routed CareerFlow without live LLM calls.
A non-critical CareerFlow node failure degrades gracefully and is recorded instead of crashing the flow.
Application proposals carry stable IDs and replaying a proposal is idempotent.
